chunks.text: It’s been one of those rainy Tuesday evenings… I’m thinking I should finally get serious about brushing up on data structures, and I’ve also been meaning to pick up something like "Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind" to read again. Oh—and I’m a bit congested, so I’m curious what over-the-counter cold meds are around right now.
Yeah, that works—go ahead and reserve "Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind" under Mason White.
Also, if there’s a solid option for a Data Structures and Algorithms course, I’m ready to just enroll—put it under Xu Jing.
